basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic design enthusiast from Portland, Oregon, currently working as a freelance designer. My interests range from brutalist architecture to aviation. I enjoy late-night Reddit browsing and often find myself contributing to discussions about design and refereeing. I'm single and currently navigating the complexities of modern relationships, which is a frequent topic in my online conversations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design from a local university and have been freelancing for about a year. My interest in architecture, particularly brutalism, comes from self-study and visiting various structures during my travels. My knowledge of aviation is more of a hobby, fueled by documentaries and online communities.
